text: {"features":[{"evidence":"The moment that shaped my engineering priorities ... / Every security team I have seen has the same bottleneck","name":"Narrative voice","description":"This captures how memorable, purposeful, and role-specific the letter's framing is rather than how generic or templated it feels.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Flat or boilerplate framing that could fit many software roles and gives little sense of the applicant's point of view."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Competent but conventional framing with some role relevance, though the voice remains interchangeable with many other applicants."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Distinct framing that clearly reflects this role or this applicant's motivation and makes the letter easier to remember."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"A sharp, memorable thesis or opening that feels authentic, tightly role-specific, and helps organize the rest of the letter."}]},{"evidence":"frequent misspellings like taem, trining, gnippihs","name":"Proofreading quality","description":"This captures surface polish and whether spelling or typographical errors distract from the applicant's substance.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frequent or severe errors materially distract, create confusion, or make the letter feel careless."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Several noticeable typos appear and reduce polish, though the meaning is still clear."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Only a few minor errors appear and they do not meaningfully impede reading."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Essentially error-free and professionally polished."}]},{"evidence":"Doctoral degree in computer science","name":"Formal academic credential","description":"This captures how advanced the applicant's stated formal education is relative to the role's minimum and preferred qualifications.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows only the minimum academic baseline, such as a bachelor's degree or equivalent, or leaves advanced study unclear."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows a relevant master's degree or comparable graduate training."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a doctorate or similarly strong research-oriented training in a relevant field."}]},{"evidence":"7 years of software development experience","name":"Relevant professional tenure","description":"This captures how far beyond the minimum experience requirement the applicant's stated software engineering tenure goes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Experience is unclear or appears below the role's baseline."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Roughly meets the minimum, with about 2 to 3 years of relevant work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid experience beyond the minimum, with about 4 to 5 years."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows deep experience for this level, with about 6 or more years."}]},{"evidence":"launching 6 production services","name":"Production delivery scope","description":"This captures the breadth of concrete production lifecycle ownership the letter claims across testing, maintenance, and launches.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives little concrete production ownership or mentions only minimal shipped scope."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows involvement with a small number of production services or a limited slice of the lifecycle."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows ownership across several production services with testing, maintenance, or launch responsibilities."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows broad production ownership across many services or unusually strong end-to-end delivery scope."}]},{"evidence":"someone always inherits what we build","name":"Maintainer mindset","description":"This captures whether the letter presents maintenance, failure experience, and long-term operability as a guiding engineering philosophy.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No maintainer or operational mindset is visible."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions maintenance or testing as duties but does not turn that into a design perspective."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explicitly frames the applicant as a maintainer who values durability, inheritance, or real-world failure modes."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Uses maintenance or failure experience to explain a clear philosophy for how secure systems should be designed and operated."}]},{"evidence":"foundation layer ... inherited by every team downstream","name":"Platform leverage orientation","description":"This captures how strongly the applicant is motivated by foundational work whose benefits compound across many teams or products.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention foundational leverage or broader organizational impact."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses a general desire for scale or impact but without a clear platform orientation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explicitly wants infrastructure or foundational work that benefits many teams."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Repeatedly frames motivation around downstream leverage, central-platform responsibility, or quiet improvements inherited across an organization."}]},{"evidence":"make secure development the default","name":"Developer enablement mindset","description":"This captures whether the letter frames security as helping developers succeed through good tooling and defaults rather than control or paperwork.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No developer-centered security philosophy is visible."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows generic interest in improving security but not specifically in making life easier for developers."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explicitly talks about secure-by-default workflows, reducing friction, or helping teams do the right thing."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Strongly frames security as developer enablement, emphasizing defaults, tools, or guardrails over policing, process, or documents."}]},{"evidence":"too many signals, too few experts","name":"Security automation framing","description":"This captures how well the letter understands the role as a systems problem of scaling scarce security effort through automation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not clearly articulate security automation as a central problem of the role."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions reducing manual toil or automating repetitive work in general terms."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly frames the role as scaling response capacity, expert attention, or organization-wide security effort."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows nuanced systems thinking about automation, such as variant analysis, triage strategy, scarce-expert amplification, or vulnerability response as a design problem."}]},{"evidence":"Python became my workhorse","name":"Python implementation depth","description":"This captures the specificity and production maturity of the applicant's Python experience.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Python is not mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Python is mentioned only briefly or as generic familiarity."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows clear professional Python use for tooling, services, scripts, or automation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong production-grade Python work, such as major operational ownership, typed or tested services, or tooling other engineers rely on."}]},{"evidence":"turned a brute-force correlation job into a streaming computation","name":"Algorithmic fluency","description":"This captures evidence of practical use of data structures and algorithms to make systems faster, simpler, or more tractable.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No meaningful algorithmic evidence appears."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims strong data structures or algorithms knowledge but gives little or no proof."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides at least one concrete example of applying algorithmic thinking to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Provides multiple or especially strong examples showing sustained algorithmic judgment with clear technical payoff."}]},{"evidence":"shipping LLM-based features that had to behave predictably","name":"Applied AI deployment experience","description":"This captures hands-on AI or LLM work and how seriously the letter treats safe, reliable production use.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No AI experience is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI interest or exposure without concrete delivery evidence."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows experience shipping AI or LLM-backed features or workflows in production."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows production AI work plus evaluation, hardening, failure-mode management, or other reliability discipline."}]},{"evidence":"Python agents ... Go services constrain what they may touch","name":"Agentic tooling architecture","description":"This captures direct experience designing agent-based systems, especially with explicit boundaries between autonomous agents and backend control planes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No agentic tooling experience is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents or agentic systems vaguely without architectural detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building agentic systems or pipelines with clear Go and Python responsibilities."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows end-to-end architectural ownership with explicit autonomy boundaries, permissions, auditing, or guardrails."}]},{"evidence":"reports arrive classified, deduplicated, and attached to the right owner","name":"Vulnerability triage automation","description":"This captures experience automating the intake, classification, routing, or handling of vulnerability reports.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No vulnerability triage automation experience is shown."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in security automation but gives no direct triage example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives a concrete example of automating vulnerability intake, routing, or queue handling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes a detailed triage system with features like classification, deduplication, prioritization, ownership routing, or measurable impact."}]},{"evidence":"performed security assessments ... validating fixes","name":"Security assessment practice","description":"This captures whether the applicant has directly performed threat models, reviews, or other assessment work rather than only adjacent security activity.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No direct security assessment work is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows indirect security exposure only, such as general interest, competition, or certification."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows direct assessment work such as threat models, design reviews, service reviews, or formal findings."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows mature assessment practice tied to remediation, attacker or builder thinking, or broad cross-stack scrutiny."}]},{"evidence":"maintain an open-source project with a genuine user community","name":"Open-source ownership","description":"This captures whether the applicant merely uses open source, contributes fixes, or carries maintainer responsibility for projects others depend on.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No open-source activity is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions occasional patches or corrective upstream contributions."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows maintainer-level responsibility for a project or library."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows maintainer responsibility plus evidence of external users, releases, reviews, or community stewardship."}]},{"evidence":"capture-the-flag ... near the top of several major events","name":"Offensive security practice","description":"This captures ongoing adversarial skill-building outside routine development work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No offensive-security practice is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows occasional CTF participation or general attacker-minded interest."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular participation or a clear ongoing commitment to offensive practice."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows serious competitive results or especially strong evidence that attacker practice materially sharpens the applicant's engineering perspective."}]},{"evidence":"earned the OSCP certification","name":"Security certification signal","description":"This captures third-party validation of security knowledge or hands-on offensive capability.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No certification or only informal learning is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows a foundational certification such as Security+."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a demanding practical credential such as OSCP or an equivalent hands-on certification."}]},{"evidence":"building a distributed task queue with exactly-once semantics","name":"Personal project ambition","description":"This captures whether side projects show disciplined finishing, technical curiosity, or unusually ambitious systems work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No side project is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small or utilitarian personal app or tool with limited technical challenge."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a sustained side project with nontrivial systems, infrastructure, or engineering discipline."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows an ambitious distributed, reliability-heavy, or failure-oriented project chosen specifically to tackle hard edge cases."}]},{"evidence":"measured its worth in the hours of expert attention it returned","name":"Evidence specificity","description":"This captures how often the letter backs claims with concrete examples, mechanics, counts, or outcomes rather than general assertions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mostly relies on self-assertion, with little concrete support for claims."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes some specifics, but few mechanics, numbers, or outcomes."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides several concrete examples with technical detail, counts, or before-and-after effects."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Repeatedly grounds claims in vivid, trust-building evidence, including technical mechanics and clear impact."}]},{"evidence":"Having reviewed the posting closely, I believe my background aligns directly","name":"Requirement mapping explicitness","description":"This captures how directly the letter connects the applicant's background to Google's stated requirements and responsibilities.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Leaves the reader to infer most of the match to the posting."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions relevant experience but ties it only loosely to the role."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Directly connects several experiences or skills to stated requirements or responsibilities."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explicitly walks through the posting match in a structured, requirement-aware way."}]}]}
